desc:
Unwrap a world of fruity fun with the Chewits Strawberry, Fruit Salad & Blue Raspberry Fruit Chews 4 Stick Pack! Bursting with bold, juicy flavours, each pack delivers a delicious mix of classic strawberry, nostalgic fruit salad, and vibrant blue raspberry chews.

Chewits · Multipack · Fruity
ingredients: glucose syrup, sugar, vegetable fats (palm, coconut), acid (lactic acid), concentrates from (spirulina, strawberry, orange, raspberry, pineapple, carrot, blackcurrants), natural flavourings, EGG white powder, hydrolysed pea protein, colour (carotenes).
